script: "You've been dating for a year, but is everything he told you a lie?". My boy M30 and I, F33, we've been low-key dating for almost a year now. Like, I knew he had his issues, but I had no idea how deep they went. So, his dad - allegedly dead for like, ever. Turns out, he's been lying to me about this the whole time. I am literally talking about a whole year, bestie. I only found out because his friend was over, and we were vibing about my bf's traumas. I was like, "Oh, my god, dude, how did you deal?" And his friend just casually drops a bombshell - his dad died during his university days. I am talking, like, years ago. I am literally insane, right? Later, his friend spills the tea to M30, and he finally comes clean with me. Of course, he apologizes for me finding out through his friend, but, honestly, I am just trying to process. I get where he's coming from, though. The guy has lost both parents, and that's, like, the most traumatic thing ever. At first, I was hurt that he didn't trust me enough to share his pain with me. Like, wasn't I his person? But, I know I am not in his shoes, and losing both parents is, like, unimaginable. I am not even mad, bestie. I am just...disappointed. Disappointed that he thought he needed to carry this secret for so long. But, I guess we all carry our own burdens, and sometimes it takes someone else to help us share the weight. Now that we've talked about it, I feel a little better. We're working on rebuilding that trust, and I am trying to be more understanding. I mean, we all have our own stuff, and sometimes it takes a friend to help us spill the tea. And, honestly? I am just glad we can move forward from here.
